column1: # Upstream components of motanka-stack-shell: Quickshell, the desktop shell
# of upstream Omarchy v4.5.0, and cpptrace, which its crash handler needs;
# omasnap, Upstream's screenshot tool, and layer-shell-qt, which it needs.
# Same format as stack/components.tsv (see the comment there). Built by
# both suites, against the Stack's Qt 6.12 (motanka-qt6) on both.
#   wayland            noble only, build time only, the Stack's version
#                      protocol.h uses the include guard of the system's
#                      included first, hides wl_fixes and Quickshell fails to
#                      compile. The staged 1.24 headers come first instead;
#                      at run time Quickshell loads the Stack's libwayland
#   wayland-protocols  build time only, the Stack's version (1.50, same
#                      tarball and checksum as stack/components.tsv), so
#                      Quickshell sees the same protocols as Hyprland on
#                      both releases. omasnap takes its ext-image-capture-
#                      source and ext-image-copy-capture XML from here too:
#   libdwarf-lite      build "source": not built on its own. cpptrace's
#                      CMake fetches it from git at configure time, which
#                      the network-less sbuild chroot cannot do, so the
#                      folder. The version must be the one cpptrace pins as
#   cpptrace           shared, with libunwind (Quickshell's crash handler
#                      refuses it otherwise); libcpptrace ships in
#   quickshell         the GitHub mirror's tag; no git submodules.
#   cmake              noble only, build time only, the Stack's CMake
#                      layer-shell-qt and omasnap are configured with it;
#                      cpptrace and Quickshell keep the archive's CMake.
#                      resolute's own CMake is new enough.
#   extra-cmake-modules  KDE's CMake modules (ECM), build time only:
#   layer-shell-qt     KDE's Qt client library for wlr-layer-shell, built
#                      uses Qt's private API of the archive's Qt (6.4 or
#                      6.10) and cannot load with Qt 6.12. Ships
#                      integration plugin and the org.kde.layershell QML
#   omasnap            Upstream's screenshot and annotation tool
#                      makes that folder a cache variable, which the build
# Download, verify and pin: stack/fetch-sources --components stack/shell-components.tsv
